items.title: The PR picker of the review command closes when a search fails
items.description: In the review command I pick a specific pull request, then search the open pull requests by text. When the GitHub search call fails (for example when it is rate limited), the whole picker ends and I have to start again. After a failed search I want to stay in the picker, see the list I had before, and still be able to choose a pull request.
acceptance_criteria: A failed search leaves the picker open on the previous list.
The user can still select a pull request after the failure and the review continues for it.
